entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud SDK.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: A high-performance memory engine featuring sub-300ms recall and a custom vector graph engine capable of sustaining 100B+ tokens per month. It integrates automated fact extraction with connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub, utilizing byte-level deduplication for cost efficiency.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory using a virtual filesystem with viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is designed to reduce token consumption by up to 91% while providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging query paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that extracts typed entity edges from pages without requiring LLM calls. It supports serverless deployment via PGLite and generates synthesized prose answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that offers hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers and includes a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider manages context as a git-like repository, featuring version control operations like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates with sub-millisecond latency using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy that ensures agents prioritize specific injected context and an auto-curated wiki for knowledge management.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as playbooks and datasets to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports local-model training and schema-enforced role outputs while integrating with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine and SQLite-backed store to ensure no messages are lost. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical structure, providing specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides identity, memory, and secrets for agents, supporting portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and can import data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML engram format designed for multi-agent systems. It offers local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks using hybrid retrieval including BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% of tokens. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by returning a why_retrieved tag with every recall. It includes contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It supports stdio and SSE MCP servers and requires no account.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory. It features a 1-10 importance ranking system to prioritize high-value recalls and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through semantic search and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering specific tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle self-directed payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates financial autonomy by enabling APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them within a few lines of code.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports advanced retrieval techniques including configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of stored memory searches.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It offers flexible execution via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon, utilizing HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication for efficient data management.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on indexing local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for agent routing. It provides tools for neighbor traversal and usage reporting, with an optional feature for generating tool-routing notes via model calls.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Operating entirely over localhost, this plugin provides private local code memory for repositories. It enables semantic and literal code searches and supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development for engineering tasks while enforcing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology compatible with harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 artifacts from design systems through a sandboxed iframe preview. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including specific integrations for Hermes and DeepSeek Harness.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from ingested data. It supports cross-session memory management through Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to six industry frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. The library is designed for compatibility with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It features self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Utilizing a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table, this tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates the evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement of skills across multiple agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and various OpenAI-compatible APIs to unify agent capabilities.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce that facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It provides adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution by connecting fragmented ecosystem layers into a single skill.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers spec-conformant Agent Plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local docs/ folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The library includes ready-to-paste exports for use in other assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this tool provides YouTube search, transcript, channel, and playlist capabilities for agents. It is formatted for compatibility with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task and card management.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This toolkit provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers prompting guidelines for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models alongside API integration documentation. It includes a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides version-pinned skills with an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI for managing reusable AI skills. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON-based commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to define 'Intent as Code.' It provides static auditing via 'nika check' and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts for any LLM.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, featuring a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent that uses hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation if embedding models are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various platforms like Discord and Telegram, tailoring optimizations based on model family and reasoning capabilities. It preserves non-English prompts using Unicode-range heuristics and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Hermeshub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard is a read-only code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles, such as exploitability and integration impact. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Ruff with sandbox execution to verify findings.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements verified procedures including multi-story task decomposition and mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It features a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a three-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system to categorize modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, covering real exploits from 2015 through 2026.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC through protocols such as Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. This skill is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Provides functional quality certification for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: Generates structured Chinese news briefings across geographic scales ranging from global to street level. The tool includes core conclusions, action suggestions, and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers a suite of tools including video-to-text transcription, local OCR for PDFs and images, and batch e-commerce material generation. These capabilities support tasks such as AI text de-humanization and brand overlay application.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes. The packages are automatically updated daily and include tools from both binary and source origins.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices using proot-distro. It supports local models via Ollama and is compatible with multiple AI model providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces from a single web application. It offers enterprise MCP access and supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and task scheduling.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable Hermes Agent runs from a USB or any drive without requiring host system installation. It supports Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes simultaneously and includes bundled Python 3.12 and Sysinternals rescue tools.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with support for data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools like Cursor and Claude Code. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device sync and is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It coordinates seven specialized agents and includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This tool provides community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM/GGUF inference.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and undo functionality for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph and CrewAI. It includes memory tools for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, as well as a plugin for Claude Code with automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and specialized agents while maintaining local skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies technical issues such as overlapping descriptions, inconsistent schemas, and missing stop conditions through local execution or CI/CD pipelines.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and maps existing credentials into the Hermes architecture.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes performance baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities, operating entirely locally without the need for API keys or accounts.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified interface for managing multiple agentic tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that unifies multiple external agents like OpenClaw and Hermes Agent into a single interface. It offers remote access through WebUI and various messaging platforms, including Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat, and includes 21 built-in professional assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JS-based web interface designed for accessing Hermes Agent via a browser or SSH tunnel. It features a workspace file browser with inline preview capabilities.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app that facilitates the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard that supports multi-platform AI chat, session management, and scheduled jobs. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban boards, usage analytics, and channel configuration for 10 platforms such as Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and includes a Monaco-based file browser.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports task delegation to sub-agents and is available as a desktop or self-hosted app with native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects directly to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that also supports macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and Hermes Web Alpha for session and runtime management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted Hermes agents. It allows users to manage sessions, tasks, and skills, while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm agent health. It integrates a browser-based terminal and file explorer with real-time chat features, including streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks analytics and limits for Hermes alongside other coding-agent CLIs. It provides searchable transcript history, image browsing, and live per-session quota burn-rates for specific models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It distinguishes itself with an integrated WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project provides a terminal-based interface and dashboard for managing Hermes profiles, skills, and cron jobs. It includes a dedicated kanban board for tracking agentic work and task management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This self-hostable dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It features a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to validate Telegram sessions while providing a terminal chat with file attachments.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes with local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers and includes built-in support for ComfyUI and TTS.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for the self-hosted assistant. Users can manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through an integrated file browser and management suite.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process oversight by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native streaming SSE responses.
